# Holaweb

> Africa's all-in-one Business Operating System — websites, payments, CRM, WhatsApp & Meta Business Suite for SMEs.

Holaweb Media Group is a South African digital solutions company building cloud-powered products that help African entrepreneurs sell, get paid, and grow.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Holaweb Business OS for African SMEs.
- [About](/about): Company mission, leadership, and story.
- [Platform](/platform): Product pillars — websites, payments, CRM, messaging, analytics.
- [Demo](/demo): Video walkthrough of the platform.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch and request a personalised quote.

## Services

- [Cloud Services](/services/cloud-services): AWS-backed cloud hosting and infrastructure.
- [Web & App Development](/services/web-app-development): Custom websites and applications.
- [Market Access](/services/market-access): Go-to-market and growth services.
- [META Solutions](/services/meta-solutions): WhatsApp Business and Meta Business Suite setup.
